items.d: Floor plans, wall elevations, room schedules — vector or scanned. No CAD needed.
Every line is marked: read from the drawing, computed with an assumption, or a default. You check only what is flagged.
Excel with live formulas, or a Lithuanian-format PDF with the 21% VAT line.

reads.title: What Pathon reads from your drawings
reads.note: Every number carries its unit and a link to the exact spot on the drawing it came from.

trust.sub: Every quantity shows where it came from: read straight off the drawing, computed from an assumption, or a default. The system surfaces the few lines worth a review before you quote — the rest are already done.

cards.d: The value comes straight from the room schedule or the plan geometry. Sources cross-checked.
E.g. the ceiling height came from a section, not the room table. The assumption is visible and editable.
Nothing found in the drawing, so a standard value was used. Check it before you quote.

assumptions.intro: Every change here recalculates the quantities immediately — wall paint, skim, reveals, skirting, tiling and the rest. There is no “Save” button.
assumptions.demoReadonly: This is a sample project, for viewing only. These are the settings the calculations rest on. Upload your own drawing and you can change them, with the quantities recalculating live.
assumptions.windowsNotFound: No windows found in the drawings
assumptions.windowsNotFoundDesc: Standard suggestions by room type are provided. Check and adjust below.
assumptions.wallThicknessNote: 0.10 m — used only for the reveal area; it barely moves the quantities. LT partitions are typically 0.075–0.10 m, blockwork 0.20–0.25 m.
assumptions.puttyLevelNote: A higher level means more skim and more sanding labour.
assumptions.ceilingHeightNote: Directly affects the paintable wall area (perimeter × height) and the drywall ceiling sheet count. If it's one house — use the „All rooms" field below; if heights differ (e.g. attic, garage) — enter per room individually.
assumptions.allRoomsTitle: Enter one height, press Enter — it will be applied to all rooms
assumptions.wallsPaintNote: Some rooms — garage, vestibule — are treated as bare by default. Click to change; the paintable area recalculates live.
assumptions.stretchCeilingNote: Mark the rooms that get a stretch ceiling — their ceiling skimming, priming, painting and sanding drop out of the estimate. Cornice, LED niches and plasterboard ceilings stay.
assumptions.heightRangeErr: Ceiling height must be between {{min}} and {{max}} m.
assumptions.headerTitle: The settings the calculations rest on — skim quality, mixers, wall thickness, height per room
assumptions.introOrphans: A few rows may keep their original values — we will say which ones separately.
assumptions.wallThicknessHint: Partition thickness in metres — used for the reveals row
assumptions.wallThicknessRangeErr: Wall thickness must be between {{min}} and {{max}} m.

roomSheet.title: Room check sheet
roomSheet.noOutline: This room has no outline on the drawing — only its number's position is shown.
roomSheet.noOpeningMarks: The drawing gives no positions for doors and windows, so none are marked on the plan. The count and sizes are on the card.
roomSheet.cropFailed: The crop could not be shown. Open the drawing.
roomSheet.wholeSheetWhy: I do not know the exact spot on this sheet — showing the whole sheet.
roomSheet.openingsAssumed: standard sizes — change them if yours differ
roomSheet.wallsConsequence: Not painted: no wall skimming, painting or corners for this room in the estimate.
roomSheet.paskirtisConsequence: The use drives more than the floor — wall and tile rules follow from it too.
roomSheet.quantitiesEmpty: Nothing from this room reaches the estimate.
roomSheet.noLedger: Quantities for this room are not prepared yet — press “Recalculate”.
roomSheet.overrideShared: This room's share cannot be corrected yet — fix the fact above, or the whole line in the estimate.
roomSheet.overrideSaved: Saved. A recalculation will not overwrite your number.
roomSheet.cornersHighlighted: The corners are marked on the plan on the left.
roomSheet.rippleNone: Recalculated — the quantities did not change.
roomSheet.generalIntro: Not everything comes from the rooms. Check these once for the whole project.
roomSheet.generalCeilingWhy: Ceiling quantities are billed off this number, not off the sum of the rooms.
roomSheet.generalSymbolsWhy: Counted on the plan. Doesn't match? — correct the number here.
roomSheet.generalCeilingPlanTitle: Sum of the areas written on the plan
roomSheet.generalCeilingPlanWhy: The drawing prints no room schedule — ceiling quantities are taken from the room areas written on the plan, not from the sum of the rooms.
roomSheet.generalAuthorIntro: The designer wrote these numbers on the drawing itself. Compare them with ours — we do not take them over, we compute from the drawing.
roomSheet.generalAuthorWhy: Written on the drawing (p. {{page}}). More than a tenth apart? — check which rooms the designer included.
roomSheet.generalAuthorNoOurs: Written on the drawing (p. {{page}}). We do not compute such a row — add it yourself if you need it.
roomSheet.scopeRoomOnNote: The room is in every row. If it is not yours or a duplicate, switch it off: none of its rows will be in the estimate.
roomSheet.scopeRoomOffNote: The room stays on the sheet but is in no row at all — not walls, ceilings, floors or materials.
roomSheet.scopeIntro: How you work on this job. Change one and the quantities recompute at once.

scopeLubosNote.dazomos: Ceiling skimming and painting rows are taken from the schedule area.
scopeLubosNote.ne_musu: No ceiling skimming, priming or painting rows in the estimate. Where a room says otherwise, the room's choice wins.
scopeLubosNote.itempiamos: Stretch ceilings — no skimming or painting; cornice, LED niches and plasterboard stay. Where a room says otherwise, the room's choice wins.

scopeSienosNote.atimti: Door and window openings are deducted from the wall area.
scopeSienosNote.neatimti: Walls are measured straight through the openings — as many finishers do, since cut-outs are waste and labour.

roomSheet.scopeFamiliesNote: Rows of an unticked area will not be in the estimate, along with its materials. Sections belonging to no area always stay.
roomSheet.scopeRoomFamiliesNote: An unticked area leaves this room's rows and their materials. Plumbing and electrics are counted per project — on the general page.

scopeRotbandNote.dalis: Masonry and concrete walls are levelled, plasterboard partitions are not. The drawing does not state wall types, so you set the share; until then a 30 % assumption is used.
scopeRotbandNote.nera: No wall levelling row or Rotband material in the estimate.
scopeRotbandNote.visos: The whole painted wall area is levelled.

roomSheet.unclaimedTitle: Areas written on the plan with no room
roomSheet.unclaimedIntro: These areas are written on the drawing but no room that was read carries them — most likely a room was missed. Add it if it is yours; set its purpose and perimeter on its sheet.
roomSheet.unclaimedWhy: Written on the plan (p. {{page}}), inside no room.
roomSheet.roomAdded: Room {{nr}} added — set its purpose and check the perimeter on its sheet.

scopeKampaiNote.su_vidiniais: Bead on each room's four inner corners as well as on openings and partition ends.
scopeKampaiNote.tik_isoriniai: Bead only on openings (doors, windows) and partition ends — inner room corners are skimmed without bead.

preflight.disclaimer: A quick guess from the PDF’s text, not a result.
preflight.pickAnotherTitle: Remove this file and upload another
preflight.overrideBlockTitle: Continue knowing that pages past the 100th will not be read

verdict.interior_plan: This looks like an interior design project — the kind we read best.
verdict.table_only: This looks like a bill-of-quantities table rather than a drawing — we probably will not find rooms. Continue anyway?
verdict.photo_or_scan: This PDF is photos or scans with no text. The quantities will still be calculated, but they will need a closer check.
verdict.facade_or_site: These look like facade or site drawings rather than interior plans — we probably will not find rooms. Continue anyway?
verdict.mixed_bundle: This looks like a full technical set — the interior drawings are only part of the file. Every page will be read.
verdict.unknown: We could not tell what kind of drawings these are. It may still work.

q.objectNote: Used in the project name — it does not change any quantity.
q.ceilingLabel: Ceiling height, if you know it
q.ceilingNote: 2.80 m — the usual one. You can leave it empty: heights come from the drawing. Your number waits in settings — one click applies it wherever the drawing gives no height.

lubosNote.dazomos: Ceiling skimming and painting rows come from the schedule area. Any room can be marked otherwise later.
lubosNote.ne_musu: No ceiling skimming, priming or painting rows in the estimate.
lubosNote.itempiamos: Stretch ceilings — no skimming or painting; cornice, LED niches and plasterboard stay.

sienosNote.atimti: Door and window openings are deducted from the wall area.
sienosNote.neatimti: Walls are measured straight through the openings — cut-outs are waste and labour.

q.rememberedNote: As on your last 3 projects — change it if this one is different.
q.familiesAllNote: All ticked. Untick one and its rows will not be in the estimate (nor the materials bought for them).
q.familiesSomeOffNote: Rows from the unticked areas will not be in the estimate, along with their materials. Sections that belong to no area (ventilation, for example) always stay.
